patch_description: Replace the multi-stage Kalman/Holt/gating pipeline with a single recency-weighted Savitzky-Golay convolution, which is the proven mechanism in this lineage: SG with a quadratic fit over a wide window suppresses noise strongly (helping the binding smoothness 0.33 and noise_reduction 0.33) while polynomial order 2 preserves trend curvature without lag, and exponential recency weighting compensates group delay (unlike slope extrapolation which failed in earlier generations). Vectorizing as a single convolution also keeps execution time low.
